This is the second quest to acquire [[Margrid the Sly]] as a hero. It leads you from [[Yohlon Haven]] to [[Pogahn Passage (outpost)|Pogahn Passage]].

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
* Show the Map of Gandara to [[Jack of Truths]] in [[Pogahn Passage (outpost)|Pogahn Passage]].
* Waylay a squad of Kournan guards and "borrow" their armor.
* Don the Kournan armor.
* See Jack of Truths for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* [[Margrid the Sly]] joins your party.
* 200 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Just walk from [[Yohlon Haven]] to the east through the [[Arkjok Ward]]. When walking through the fortress, be careful not to aggro the [[Acolyte of Grenth]]. When you reach [[Pogahn Passage (outpost)|Pogahn Passage]], you will find the doors shut. Just walk north a bit and you will find the entrance. At the other end of Pogahn Passage, you will find [[Jack of Truths]]. Follow the quest-marker in Pogahn Passage through the water and out to [[Gandara]]. Kill the Kournans and pick up the Sets of Kournan Armor. As soon as you "put them on", the cinematic starts. Talk to Jack of Truths for your reward.

==Notes==
*Should you abandon the quest, Margrid can be found in [[Marga Coast]] just outside [[Yohlon Haven]], where she will offer you the quest again.
*If you have already been to [[Pogahn Passage (outpost)|Pogahn Passage]] you can travel there directly by map. You can alternatively start in [[Kodonur Crossroads]], but you will have to defeat many more enemies.

==Trivia==
*The [[Sets of Kournan Armor]] appears like a [[NPC]] and not as a [[quest item]].
*Margrid the Sly's initial dialogue previously began with ''"I am starting to like you, Istani."'' It has since been changed to remove "Istani" from the end of the sentence.
